name: MonarchPreviewRows
title: PreviewRows
summary: The rows of an import file as the import will treat them: each row's number, outcome (ready, warning, error, duplicate), values and problems, with filter tabs and counts.
whenToUse: In an import flow, after the file is read and before anything is written, so people can see which rows will be imported, which will be skipped and why.
whenNotToUse: For records already stored, use a list or a table. For a summary of an import that has finished, use a result screen with counts.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPreviewRows(rows: List<MonarchPreviewRow>, columns: List<MonarchPreviewRowsColumn>, label: String, filter: MonarchPreviewRowStatus?, onFilterChange: (MonarchPreviewRowStatus?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, filterable: Boolean = true, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), statusIcon: (@Composable (MonarchPreviewRowStatus) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchPreviewRowsLabels = MonarchPreviewRowsLabels())

class MonarchPreviewRow(row: Int, values: Map<String, String?>, status: MonarchPreviewRowStatus? = null, errors: List<MonarchPreviewRowIssue> = emptyList(), warnings: List<MonarchPreviewRowIssue> = emptyList(), note: String? = null) { val outcome: MonarchPreviewRowStatus }
class MonarchPreviewRowIssue(message: String, field: String? = null)
class MonarchPreviewRowsColumn(id: String, label: String, numeric: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchPreviewRowStatus { Ready, Warning, Error, Duplicate }

class MonarchPreviewRowsLabels(filter: String? = null, all: String? = null, ready: String? = null, warning: String? = null, error: String? = null, duplicate: String? = null, row: ((row: Int) -> String)? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, filteredTitle: String? = null, noValue: String? = null)

options.name: rows
options.description: The rows of the file: number, values by column id, errors, warnings, an optional status override and a note.

options.name: columns
options.description: The columns to show for each row, in order. numeric draws tabular figures.

options.name: label
options.description: The TalkBack name of the preview, for example "Preview of contacts.csv".

options.name: filter
options.description: The outcome shown, or null for every row.

options.name: onFilterChange
options.description: Called with the outcome chosen in the tabs, or null for All and for Clear filters.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the list. Give it a bounded height.

options.name: filterable
options.description: Shows the filter tabs when some row is not ready, or a filter is chosen.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the list.

options.name: statusIcon
options.description: An icon for each outcome, drawn in its badge. Monarch bundles no icons; the outcome is written either way.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the strings monarch_previewrows_*, including the status names and the row heading.

states.name: every row
states.description: The All tab is selected; each row shows its heading, outcome badge, values and problems.

states.name: filtered
states.description: Only rows with the chosen outcome; the tab of that outcome is selected.

states.name: filter matches nothing
states.description: A filtered MonarchEmptyState, "No rows with this result", with Clear filters.

states.name: no rows
states.description: A MonarchEmptyState, "No rows to preview", and no tabs.

states.name: all ready
states.description: No tabs: every row has the Ready badge.

appearance: Rows separated by subtle dividers. Each starts with "Row 4" in the label style and an outcome badge: success for Ready, warning for Warning, danger for Error, info for Duplicate. Field names and missing-value dashes are muted, errors use the strong danger color and warnings the strong warning color, notes are muted captions. The tabs are Material 3 secondary tabs with a count badge, danger for errors and warning for warnings. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web shows a DataTable on wide screens and cards on phones, with 50 rows per page; on Android every row is a card in a LazyColumn, which needs no pages. The web filter can be uncontrolled; on Android it is hoisted (filter and onFilterChange). Cell values are strings, not arbitrary nodes, and the note is text. The web draws a glyph for each outcome; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so statusIcon is a slot and the outcome is written. The web exports previewRowStatus and countPreviewRows; on Android the outcome is MonarchPreviewRow.outcome. iOS has no entry yet; the names follow the web.
accessibility: The list is named by label; the tabs are named "Show rows".
Each row is one TalkBack element that reads its heading (marked as a heading), outcome, values and problems; a missing value is read as "No value".
Each problem is read with its kind first: "Error: Seats: Required".
The filter tabs have the Tab role, their selected state and a 48dp touch target, and read their name with the count.
The outcome is always written in the badge; color is never the only signal.
Values and problems wrap at the largest font size and the heading and badge follow the layout direction.
edgeCases: A chosen filter whose outcome has no rows keeps its tab, so it can still be seen as selected.
Row numbers are the keys of the lazy list, so they must be unique.
Values for columns that are not listed in columns are not shown.

examples.template:
MonarchPreviewRows(
    rows = listOf(
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = {{rows.0.row}},
            values = mapOf({{columns.0.id}} to {{rows.0.values.name}}, {{columns.1.id}} to {{rows.0.values.email}}, {{columns.2.id}} to {{rows.0.values.country}}),
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = {{rows.1.row}},
            values = mapOf({{columns.0.id}} to {{rows.1.values.name}}, {{columns.1.id}} to {{rows.1.values.email}}, {{columns.2.id}} to {{rows.1.values.country}}),
            errors = listOf(MonarchPreviewRowIssue({{rows.1.errors.0.message}}, field = {{rows.1.errors.0.field}}), MonarchPreviewRowIssue({{rows.1.errors.1.message}}, field = {{rows.1.errors.1.field}})),
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = {{rows.2.row}},
            values = mapOf({{columns.0.id}} to {{rows.2.values.name}}, {{columns.1.id}} to {{rows.2.values.email}}, {{columns.2.id}} to {{rows.2.values.country}}),
            warnings = listOf(MonarchPreviewRowIssue({{rows.2.warnings.0.message}}, field = {{rows.2.warnings.0.field}})),
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = {{rows.3.row}},
            values = mapOf({{columns.0.id}} to {{rows.3.values.name}}, {{columns.1.id}} to {{rows.3.values.email}}, {{columns.2.id}} to {{rows.3.values.country}}),
            status = MonarchPreviewRowStatus.{{rows.3.status|pascal}},
            note = {{rows.3.note}},
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = {{rows.4.row}},
            values = mapOf({{columns.0.id}} to {{rows.4.values.name}}, {{columns.1.id}} to {{rows.4.values.email}}, {{columns.2.id}} to {{rows.4.values.country}}),
        ),
    ),
    columns = listOf(
        MonarchPreviewRowsColumn({{columns.0.id}}, {{columns.0.label}}),
        MonarchPreviewRowsColumn({{columns.1.id}}, {{columns.1.label}}),
        MonarchPreviewRowsColumn({{columns.2.id}}, {{columns.2.label}}),
    ),
    label = {{caption}},
    filter = filter,
    onFilterChange = { filter = it },
    modifier = Modifier.height(1040.dp),
    statusIcon = { status ->
        when (status) {
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Ready -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Success, null)
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Warning -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Warning, null)
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Error -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Cancel, null)
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Duplicate -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, null)
        }
    },
)
examples.code:
MonarchPreviewRows(
    rows = listOf(
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = 1,
            values = mapOf("name" to "Ana Ruiz", "email" to "ana@example.com", "country" to "Spain"),
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = 2,
            values = mapOf("name" to "", "email" to "not-an-email", "country" to "France"),
            errors = listOf(MonarchPreviewRowIssue("Not an email address", field = "Email"), MonarchPreviewRowIssue("Required", field = "Name")),
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = 3,
            values = mapOf("name" to "Sam Lee", "email" to "sam@example.com", "country" to "Atlantis"),
            warnings = listOf(MonarchPreviewRowIssue("Not recognised; left empty", field = "Country")),
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = 4,
            values = mapOf("name" to "Kim Park", "email" to "kim@example.com", "country" to "Korea"),
            status = MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Duplicate,
            note = "Matches an existing record",
        ),
        MonarchPreviewRow(
            row = 5,
            values = mapOf("name" to "Lee Chen", "email" to "lee@example.com", "country" to "Canada"),
        ),
    ),
    columns = listOf(
        MonarchPreviewRowsColumn("name", "Name"),
        MonarchPreviewRowsColumn("email", "Email"),
        MonarchPreviewRowsColumn("country", "Country"),
    ),
    label = "Preview of contacts.csv",
    filter = filter,
    onFilterChange = { filter = it },
    modifier = Modifier.height(1040.dp),
    statusIcon = { status ->
        when (status) {
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Ready -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Success, null)
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Warning -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Warning, null)
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Error -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Cancel, null)
            MonarchPreviewRowStatus.Duplicate -> MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Copy, null)
        }
    },
)

parityExceptions.reason: The dash shown for a row without problems is decorative punctuation; TalkBack reads the row's own Issues caption and its problems, and nothing for a row without any.
parityExceptions.convention: a placeholder dash is not announced (Material accessibility)
